description: Puts the device at latitude, longitude (WGS 84 degrees) until clear_location, like the Android Studio emulator's Location controls; shown in the dashboard. Emulators: their GPS fix moves. Physical devices (Android 12+): mock location providers replace gps, network and fused (refreshed every second), so apps that refuse mock locations ignore it; the real location comes back with clear_location or when Lionscope stops. warning says when apps will not see it (e.g. the device's location switch is off). Tell the user, and clear it when you are done. Device control.

serial.description: adb serial; default: the session device, or the only ready one.

name: set_location
title: Set the device location
